recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic, high-contrast image featuring a bust of a man carved from white marble, adorned with a luxurious fur coat and prominent gold and diamond jewelry. The marble texture includes subtle veining and carved details on the face and beard. The typography is bold and impactful, set against a light, textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: The marble bust's texture and details contrast with the soft, fluffy texture of the fur coat.
The metallic sheen of the gold and diamonds provides a focal point and adds a touch of opulence.
The dark, bold typography stands out against the light background and the figure's shoulder.
The overall monochromatic scheme is punctuated by the warm gold tones of the jewelry and the deep red of the main title.
coreInvariants: The central figure is a bust of a man, rendered in a marble-like texture.
The figure wears a fur coat and prominent, ornate jewelry.
The color palette is predominantly grayscale with accents of gold and a deep red/maroon.
The background is light and subtly textured.
The typography is bold and stacked, with a smaller, more refined subtitle.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The marble bust occupies the majority of the left and center of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left. Its scale is large, dominating the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face of the marble bust and the large medallion necklace serve as the primary visual anchors, drawing the eye with their detail and contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the face down to the necklace, then across to the bold typography on the right, and finally to the smaller text elements and the parental advisory label.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant of the image contains significant negative space, which is used to house the album title and artist name, balancing the visual weight of the figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The dominant colors are shades of white and light gray, creating the marble and fur textures, providing a clean and luxurious base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep maroon/red for the main typography and black for the parental advisory label provide strong contrast against the light background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and rose gold tones in the jewelry add warmth and opulence, serving as key accent colors.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The image features a high value range, with bright whites and light grays, contrasted by deep, rich maroon and black. Saturation is generally low for the marble and fur, with higher saturation in the gold accents and typography.
paletteRestrictions: Limit accent colors to gold/rose gold and a single deep red/maroon hue.
Avoid bright, highly saturated colors outside of the specified accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The main title uses a bold, condensed sans-serif typeface with a high x-height. The subtitle uses a wider, all-caps serif typeface. The artist's name uses the same bold sans-serif as the main title, with a dollar sign replacing 'S' characters.
letterConstructionRules: Main title and artist name use a blocky, condensed sans-serif.
Subtitle uses a classic serif with moderate stroke contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' characters in 'ROSS' are replaced with dollar signs ($), maintaining the same weight and proportion as the surrounding letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image of a marble bust of a man, wearing a white fur coat and elaborate gold and diamond jewelry, against a light, subtly textured background. Ensure the figure is positioned slightly to the left, dominating the frame. The marble should have visible veining and carved details on the face and beard. The fur should appear soft and luxurious. The jewelry should have a metallic sheen and sparkle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the typography as follows: 'SET IN STONE' in a dark gray, elegant serif font, small scale, upper right. Below it, 'RICK RO$$' in a large, bold, condensed maroon sans-serif font, with dollar signs replacing the 'S' characters. Below 'RICK RO$$', add an ornate script flourish with a small crown icon, in a brown gradient. In the lower right corner, place a 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' label in a small, bold, white sans-serif font on a black rectangle.

mustAchieve: A high level of detail and realism in the marble and fur textures.

Inconsistent lighting or unrealistic material properties.

recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a luxurious, monochromatic portrait of a figure rendered in marble, adorned with fur and prominent jewelry.
